description: Enhanced boundary coverage for composite marker construction and containment. Exercises duplicate child markers collapsing to one (set semantics), the full four-level information-classification stack, a single non-security event marker, the complete security-event triple, and substring/false-positive probes (e.g. probing 'SECRET' against a 'TOPSECRET' composite or the bare 'TOP' prefix) to confirm containment is exact-name matching, not substring matching.

cases.expected_output:
name=EVENT SUCCESS
contains[EVENT SUCCESS]=true
contains[EVENT FAILURE]=false

name=SECURITY SUCCESSSECURITY FAILURESECURITY AUDIT
contains[SECURITY SUCCESS]=true
contains[SECURITY FAILURE]=true
contains[SECURITY AUDIT]=true
contains[CONFIDENTIAL]=false
